meta.name: jev_patterns_probe
meta.scope: Mesterséges képességpróba; a küszöbök nem üzemi policy

structure.join_question: Does line {current} continue a description or sentence left unfinished at the end of line {previous}, so that both belong to ONE content block? A new purchased item, a column heading, a subtotal, a total or a separate note starts its own block even if adjacent.

join_criteria.true: A hard line wrap split one description or sentence across these two lines
join_criteria.false: These are separate items, headings, totals, notes or independent sentences

structure.block_question: What is the role of block {block} in this invoice-like text?

block_types.header: Title or table column labels, without a purchased item
block_types.item: One purchased product or service, including its description, quantities and prices if printed
block_types.total: Summary amount, subtotal, tax total or amount due for the document, not an individual item
block_types.note: Additional terms, payment instructions, exclusions or explanatory notes, not a purchased item
block_types.other: None of these, or the text does not permit a decision

pair.question: For this synthetic ONE invoice to ONE full payment comparison, how strongly does the payment identify this invoice? Use code_facts for exact amounts, currencies and reference equality; do not calculate. Identical amount and party alone do not identify a particular invoice if its reference is missing. Do not assume a partial or grouped payment.
levels: Different: incompatible parties or facts identify a different invoice
Uncertain: compatible amount and party, but missing or ambiguous reference leaves more than one plausible invoice
Same: matching invoice reference and compatible party and code facts identify the same invoice
pair.party_question: Do invoice.party and payment.party refer to the same business, allowing ordinary abbreviations and omitted legal suffixes?

hierarchy.question: Classify the purchased item or service described by the text into the best matching category. Classify what is purchased, not equipment merely mentioned. If it fits none of the offered categories, choose other.
hierarchy.other: None of these categories applies, or insufficient information to decide

goods.description: Purchased physical goods; not repair services

services.description: Purchased work performed by someone, not goods

children.repair: Repair or maintenance of existing equipment
children.training: A course, instruction or professional training

subscriptions.description: Recurring right to use software or hosting

children.software: Subscription to use a software application
children.hosting: Web server or website hosting service
